description: For "what is my pass status", "did my pass save", "my pass", "where is my Wallet pass", "send my pass again": call this tool. THE WALLET PASS. Call it when a signed-in person wants their pass for an event or a personal event this connector serves: "add it to my wallet", "put the wedding in my wallet", "I want the pass on my phone". It answers ONE LINK, good for fifteen minutes and for one tap: on an iPhone the link opens the Add to Apple Wallet sheet, on an Android phone it opens Save to Google Wallet, and no app is needed on either. Say the link and the sentence that comes with it, nothing more. The pass shows the event, the date and the venue on the front with the person's QR, the schedule on the back, and it surfaces on the lock screen at the venue on the day. The person must be signed in: an unauthenticated call is answered with the sign-in prompt. Accepts the event id or the event name.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id (lbtw_2026, test_wedding_a_garden) or the event NAME as the organizer or the hosts spell it.
